title: 第七章     离开山村，进入死亡山脉
content_zh:
天刚蒙蒙亮，此刻村子依旧是那么安静，而琼霄却早已站在了村口，身旁依然只有陈伯。

    “琼霄，陈伯准备了一些衣物还有这些年陈伯存下的金币，你拿着，出门在外要一切小心，”老人平静地整理着包裹。

    “嗯～陈伯，我走了，或许两年之后我会再回来，”琼霄从老人手中接过了包裹。旋即头也不回的朝着村外的小路走去。

    “孩子，保重！”老人眼里充满了泪花。

    “嗯，我会的！”琼霄微微一怔，头也不回的点了点头。

    望着琼霄逐渐消失的背影，老人低声道：“孩子，我相信在未来的世界里，一定会有属于你的一席之地的！”

    ……

    人影飞快的在山间小路上驰骋着，朝着小道的尽头而去，似乎没有停下来的意思……

    小道尽头。

    “我琼霄终于出来了！”琼霄朝天吼道。

    既然要到艰险的地方去历练，就必须要准备一些生存的工具才行，因此琼霄不得不到市集上去弄些野外生存的工具。

    甩开心中的惆怅，琼霄迈动着脚步融入流动的人群中消失不见。

    ……

    将所有的物资准备齐全后，琼霄便停止了忙碌，坐在客栈里休息，值得一提的是在购买物品期间，琼霄得到了一把重剑，这是用玄铁所铸成的剑，它不仅极为坚硬，而且沉重无比，最重要的，还是它具有压制星力的神奇效果，在它的压制之下，琼霄体内的星力变得缓慢起来，似乎还有点停止的节奏。

    卖剑的人不知剑的用处，只知道这把剑异常沉重，而琼霄一眼看到这把剑时立刻被一把重剑吸引住了，这把重剑居然无锋利的剑刃，琼霄心想：要是把这剑背在身上可以无时无刻不在修炼啊！因此琼霄与卖剑之人讨价还价，最终以五百金币的价格把这把重剑买了下来。可没想到刚把剑背在身上时，体内的星力立即被压制的死死的，使得突然半跪了下来。卖剑之人看到琼霄的囧样立马笑道：“小伙子，你不行啊！这样就趴下了！”

    琼霄咧咧嘴，强忍着站了起来，缓慢地朝着前方缓慢的前行……

    回想着刚才的形景，琼霄微微一笑，抚摸着这把比平常剑长出许多，且诡异无比的重剑开口道：“金庸武侠小说里面的杨过手持的那把玄铁重剑也是如此吧？”

    一晃就是中午了，琼霄点了一些菜吃了起来，在吃饭的过程中，周围的几个大汉谈论着，其中一个大汉道：“我听说死亡山脉里有着许许多多的珍贵药材，如果获得这些药材不仅可以用于自身，而且可以用来拍卖，可以获得一大把钱财！想想我都要流口水！”

    “看看，又做白日梦了不是，就你那点微末的道行还想进入捞点药材，我看啊都不够里面的魔兽塞牙缝的咧！”另一个大汉取笑道。

    “一边去，我有说我一个人进去了么，听说有雇佣兵团正在招人，想进入死亡山脉探险，你们说我们要不要去凑凑热闹，兴许可以从中获得一些好处，好补贴家用不是！”大汉兴致盎然的说着。
content_en:
It was dawn, and the village was still so quiet at this moment, but Qiong Xiao was already standing at the entrance of the village, with Uncle Chen still beside him.

    "Qiong Xiao, Uncle Chen has prepared some clothes and the gold coins that Uncle Chen has saved over the years. Take them and be careful when going out," the old man calmly packed the packages.

    "Well, Uncle Chen, I'm leaving. Maybe I will come back in two years," Qiong Xiao took the package from the old man's hand. He immediately walked towards the path outside the village without looking back.

    "Kid, take care!" The old man's eyes were filled with tears.

    "Yes, I will!" Qiong Xiao was slightly startled and nodded without looking back.

    Looking at Qiong Xiao's disappearing back, the old man whispered: "My child, I believe that there will definitely be a place for you in the future world!"

    …

    The figure was galloping quickly on the mountain path, heading towards the end of the path, and seemed to have no intention of stopping...

    End of trail.

    "I, Qiong Xiao, have finally come out!" Qiong Xiao shouted towards the sky.

    Since he was going to a dangerous place for experience, he had to prepare some survival tools, so Qiong Xiao had to go to the market to get some wild survival tools.

    Shaking off the melancholy in her heart, Qiong Xiao moved her steps and disappeared into the moving crowd.

    …

    After preparing all the supplies, Qiong Xiao stopped busy and sat in the inn to rest. It is worth mentioning that during the purchase of items, Qiong Xiao got an epee, which was made of black iron. It was not only extremely hard, but also extremely heavy. Most importantly, it had the magical effect of suppressing star power. Under its suppression, the star power in Qiong Xiao's body slowed down and seemed to stop.

    The man who sold the sword didn't know the purpose of the sword. He only knew that the sword was extremely heavy. When Qiong Xiao saw the sword, he was immediately attracted by the heavy sword. This heavy sword actually had no sharp edge. Qiong Xiao thought to herself: If I carry this sword on my back, I can practice all the time! So Qiong Xiao bargained with the sword seller and finally bought the heavy sword for five hundred gold coins. Unexpectedly, when he put the sword on his back, the star power in his body was immediately suppressed, causing him to suddenly kneel down. When the sword seller saw Qiong Xiao's embarrassment, he immediately laughed and said, "Young man, you can't do it! You'll get down like this!"

    Qiong Xiao grinned and stood up, slowly moving forward...

    Recalling the scene just now, Qiong Xiao smiled slightly, stroked the epee, which was much longer than the ordinary sword and was extremely weird, and said, "Isn't it the same as the dark iron epee held by Yang Guo in Jin Yong's martial arts novels?"

    It was noon in a flash. Qiong Xiao ordered some dishes and started eating. During the meal, several big men around him were talking. One of the big men said: "I heard that there are many precious medicinal materials in the Death Mountain. If you get these medicinal materials, you can not only use them for yourself, but also auction them, and you can get a lot of money! Thinking about it makes me drool!"

    "Look, you are daydreaming again, aren't you? With your meager skills, you still want to go in and get some medicinal materials. I can't see enough of the monsters inside to fill your teeth!" Another big man teased.

    "While going, did I mention that I went in alone? I heard that a mercenary group is recruiting people and wants to explore into the Death Mountain. Do you think we should join in the fun? Maybe we can get some benefits from it, which can help subsidize the family!" The big man said with great interest.
title_en: Chapter 7 Leaving the mountain village and entering the Death Mountains
